children.note: Count varies per row on purpose. Flush right absorbs the variation.

invariants: Logos are flush RIGHT. The rows carry different counts (3/3/5/5/6/5 in the source) and any other alignment leaves a different ragged gap on every line; right-alignment gives one clean edge down the slide.
Hairlines between every row, and below the last. They are the structure — without them six rows of logos are one undifferentiated wall.
Rows are equal height regardless of logo count. A row with three logos is not a shorter claim than a row with six.
Six logos per row is the ceiling before wordmarks collide at this size.
